question: How many trips had pickups in January 2024?
prerequisites: Node 24.22.1, pnpm 11.25.0 and desktop browser already installed
Existing Cloudflare OAuth authorization and completed Workers setup
Empty package-content store; global registry metadata and browser/CDN caches not cleared
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trips WHERE tpep_pickup_datetime >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01' AND tpep_pickup_datetime < TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01'
limitations: Existing Cloudflare authorization reused; signup and interactive login not timed.
Nondefault ports avoid interrupting the main app; matching proxy and origin overrides used.
First result observation is an upper bound; includes tool and browser interaction time.
No claim for a cold computer or a reviewer account not yet provisioned.
warnings: Nonessential Arrow CLI shim missing during install
DuckDB dependency sourcemaps reference source files outside their package
